    Proposition 4.14: descent of a multiplicative basis along a free deck group #

    prop:scalar-normalization (scalar-normalization.tex): "Let b_{xy} be the multiplicative basis constructed on L. For a free deck generator g, write g(b_{xy}) = d_g(x, y) b_{gx,gy}. The coefficients form a multiplicative weight. By Lemma 4.13, write d_g(x, y) = a_g(y)/a_g(x). On each orbit of objects solve f(gx) = a_g(x) f(x) for all free generators. The orbit graph is a Cayley tree, so a value at one root determines consistent values everywhere. Then b'_{xy} = (f(y)/f(x)) b_{xy} is still multiplicative and is deck invariant."

    For a graded family with a thin cover, a multiplicative basis β on the cover, a free grading group, and Lemma 4.13 as a hypothesis (hratio), we build the deck-invariant multiplicative basis b' (invBasis). The deck group acts on the cover by translating sheets (tr), with the same morphisms (trHom). The values f are the transport of (root, 1) under the homomorphism from the free group to permutations of objects × kˣ lifting the generators (Ψ): this is "a value at one root determines consistent values everywhere".
